answer:
I don't know of any promptfoo command that exports an evaluation to Parquet. The retrieved documents never mention Parquet.

The closest documented option is JSON export: "Export an eval record to JSON format. To export the most recent, use `latest`." [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md]

It's run as `promptfoo export eval <evalId>`, with `-o, --output <filepath>` to write to a file: "File to write. Writes to stdout by default." [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md]

The docs also show an XML output from `promptfoo eval --output results.xml`: "Full eval data for XML-only consumers" [promptfoo/site/docs/configuration/outputs.md]. None of these is Parquet. To check whether Parquet is supported, see the [output formats](/docs/configuration/outputs) page in full.
